035/**
036 * Session for parsing TOML into POJOs.
037 */
038/*
039 * Suppression rationale:
040 * - rawtypes, unchecked: TOML maps use Map<String,Object> with dynamic values requiring casts.
041 * - java:S3776: Cognitive complexity; parser logic is inherently branched for TOML syntax.
042 * - java:S6541: Brain method; parser orchestration spans many concerns.
043 * - java:S135: Multiple break/continue per loop needed for TOML state-machine parsing.
044 * - java:S1192: Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants.
045 */
046@SuppressWarnings({
047   "java:S135", // Multiple breaks acceptable in parse loop
048   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
049   "java:S1612", // Class.isAssignableFrom necessary when checking target type (Class<?>), not object instance
050   "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for readMessage
051   "java:S6541", // Brain method acceptable for readMessage
052   "rawtypes", // Raw types necessary for generic Map/List handling
053   "resource", // Closeable resources are owned by the caller's parser session; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
054   "unchecked" // Type erasure requires unchecked casts in convertValue
055})
056public class TomlParserSession extends ReaderParserSession implements RecordReadable {
057
058   private static final String MSG_INVALID_NUMBER = "Invalid number: ";
059

096   @Override /* RecordReadable */
097   public RecordReader readRecords(Object input) throws IOException {
098      return RecordAdapter.reader(this, input);

101   @Override /* RecordReadable */
102   public boolean isRecordStreaming() {

105
106   @Override
107   protected <T> T doRead(ParserPipe pipe, ClassMeta<T> type) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
108      try (Reader r = pipe.getParserReader()) {
109         if (r == null)
110            return null;
111         Map<String,Object> root = readTomlDocument(new TomlTokenizer(r));
112         if (isEmpty(root))
113            return type.canCreateNewBean(getOuter()) ? type.newInstance(getOuter()) : null;
114         // Root _value wrapper: document has exactly one key _value
115         if (root.size() == 1 && root.containsKey("_value")) {
116            Object inner = root.get("_value");
117            return (T) convertValue(inner, type);
118         }
119         return convertMapToType(root, type);
120      }
121   }
122
123   private Map<String,Object> readTomlDocument(TomlTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
124      Map<String,Object> root = m();
125      Map<String,Object> currentTable = root;
126
127      while (!t.isEof()) {
128         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
129         if (t.isEof())
130            break;
131
132         int c = t.peek();
133         if (c == '[') {
134            t.read();
135            if (t.peek() == '[') {
136               t.read();
137               String path = readTablePath(t);
138               Object existing = getOrCreateAt(root, path);
139               if (!(existing instanceof List)) {
140                  if (existing != null)
141                     throw t.parseException("Key " + path + " redefined");
142                  setAt(root, path, l());
143                  existing = getOrCreateAt(root, path);
144               }
145               Map<String,Object> newTable = m();
146               ((List)existing).add(newTable);
147               currentTable = newTable;
148            } else {
149               String path = readTablePath(t);
150               currentTable = getOrCreateTableAt(root, path);
151            }
152         } else if (c == '=' || Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '"' || c == '\'' || c == '_' || c == '-') {
153            List<String> keyPath = readKey(t);
154            if (keyPath.isEmpty())
155               throw t.parseException("Expected key");
156            t.skipWhitespace();
157            if (t.read() != '=')
158               throw t.parseException("Expected '='");
159            t.skipWhitespace();
160            Object value = readValue(t);
161            setValueAt(currentTable, keyPath, value);
162         } else {
163            break;
164         }
165      }
166      return root;
167   }
168
169   private static String readTablePath(TomlTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
170      t.skipWhitespace();
171      var parts = new ArrayList<String>();
172      while (true) {
173         String key = t.readBareKey();
174         if (key == null)
175            break;
176         parts.add(key);
177         t.skipWhitespace();
178         if (t.peek() != '.')
179            break;
180         t.read();
181         t.skipWhitespace();
182      }
183      if (t.peek() == ']')
184         t.read();
185      if (t.peek() == ']')
186         t.read();
187      return String.join(".", parts);
188   }
189
190   private static List<String> readKey(TomlTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
191      var parts = new ArrayList<String>();
192      while (true) {
193         String key = t.readBareKey();
194         if (key == null)
195            break;
196         parts.add(key);
197         t.skipWhitespace();
198         if (t.peek() != '.')
199            break;
200         t.read();
201         t.skipWhitespace();
202      }
203      return parts;
204   }
205
206   private Object readValue(TomlTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
207      enterParseDepth();
208      try {
209         return readValueImpl(t);
210      } finally {
211         exitParseDepth();
212      }
213   }
214
215   private Object readValueImpl(TomlTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
216      int c = t.peek();
217      if (c == '"') {
218         if (isTripleQuote(t, '"'))
219            return t.readMultiLineBasicString();
220         return t.readBasicString();
221      }
222      if (c == '\'') {
223         if (isTripleQuote(t, '\''))
224            return t.readMultiLineLiteralString();
225         return t.readLiteralString();
226      }
227      if (c == 't' || c == 'f')
228         return t.readBoolean();
229      if (c == '[') {
230         t.read();
231         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
232         var list = l();
233         while (t.peek() != ']') {
234            list.add(readValue(t));
235            t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
236            if (t.peek() == ',') {
237               t.read();
238               t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
239            }
240         }
241         t.read();
242         return list;
243      }
244      if (c == '{') {
245         t.read();
246         t.skipWhitespace();
247         var map = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
248         while (t.peek() != '}') {
249            t.skipWhitespace();
250            List<String> k = readKey(t);
251            if (k.isEmpty())
252               throw t.parseException("Expected key in inline table");
253            t.skipWhitespace();
254            if (t.read() != '=')
255               throw t.parseException("Expected '='");
256            t.skipWhitespace();
257            Object v = readValue(t);
258            map.put(k.get(0), v);
259            t.skipWhitespace();
260            if (t.peek() == ',') {
261               t.read();
262               t.skipWhitespace();
263            }
264         }
265         t.read();
266         return map;
267      }
268      if (Character.isDigit(c) || c == '+' || c == '-') {
269         String s = readUntilValueEnd(t);
270         if (isEmpty(s))
271            throw t.parseException("Expected value");
272         Number special = readSpecialFloat(s);
273         if (special != null)
274            return special;
275         Number radix = readRadixInteger(s, t);
276         if (radix != null)
277            return radix;
278         // TOML permits a space in place of 'T' between the date and time portions of an
279         // offset/local date-time (e.g. "2024-01-15 10:30:00"). readUntilValueEnd() above hard-stops
280         // at the first space -- a legitimate terminator for every other TOML value shape -- so
281         // without this, the time portion is silently truncated and the bare date string is returned
282         // instead. If what's been read so far is exactly a bare date and it's immediately followed by
283         // " <digit>", that space belongs to *this* value: consume it and keep reading the time part.
284         if (s.length() == 10 && s.charAt(4) == '-' && s.charAt(7) == '-' && t.peek() == ' ') {
285            t.read();
286            if (Character.isDigit(t.peek())) {
287               s = s + " " + readUntilValueEnd(t);
288            } else {
289               t.unread(' ');
290            }
291         }
292         String noUnderscore = s.replace("_", "");
293         if (s.length() >= 10 && s.charAt(4) == '-' && (s.contains("T") || s.contains(":") || s.contains(" ")))
294            return TomlTokenizer.parseDateTimeString(s);
295         // Date-like patterns kept as string for convertValue to parse as LocalDate, YearMonth, Year
296         if (isDateLikeString(noUnderscore))
297            return s;
298         if (s.contains(".") || s.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("e"))
299            return Double.parseDouble(noUnderscore);
300         try {
301            return Long.parseLong(noUnderscore);
302         } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e) {
303            // May be date/time string that slipped through (e.g. LocalDate, LocalTime)
304            if (s.contains("-") || s.contains(":"))
305               return s;
306            throw t.parseException(MSG_INVALID_NUMBER + s);
307         }
308      }
309      if (c == 'i' || c == 'n') {
310         String s = readUntilValueEnd(t);
311         Number special = readSpecialFloat(s);
312         if (special != null)
313            return special;
314         throw t.parseException("Expected inf or nan");
315      }
316      throw t.parseException("Unexpected character: " + (char)c);
317   }
318
319   private static boolean isTripleQuote(TomlTokenizer t, char q) throws IOException {
320      if (t.peek() != q) return false;
321      int c1 = t.read();
322      int c2 = t.read();
323      int c3 = t.peek();
324      if (c2 == q && c3 == q) {
325         t.read();
326         return true;
327      }
328      if (c2 >= 0)
329         t.unread(c2);
330      t.unread(c1);
331      return false;
332   }
333
334   private static boolean isDateLikeString(String s) {
335      if (s == null || s.length() < 7)
336         return false;
337      // yyyy-MM-dd (LocalDate) | yyyy-MM (YearMonth) - exclude plain 4-digit (e.g. port numbers)
338      return (s.length() == 10 && s.charAt(4) == '-' && s.charAt(7) == '-')
339         || (s.length() == 7 && s.charAt(4) == '-');
340   }
341
342   private static String readUntilValueEnd(TomlTokenizer t) throws IOException {
343      var sb = new StringBuilder();
344      int c;
345      while ((c = t.peek()) >= 0 && c != ' ' && c != '\t' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != '#' && c != ',' && c != ']' && c != '}') {
346         sb.append((char) t.read());
347      }
348      return sb.isEmpty() ? null : sb.toString().trim();
349   }
350
351   private static Number readSpecialFloat(String s) {
352      if (s == null)
353         return null;
354      if (eqa(s, "inf", "+inf"))
355         return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
356      if (eq(s, "-inf"))
357         return Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
358      if (eqa(s, "nan", "+nan", "-nan"))
359         return Double.NaN;
360      return null;
361   }
362
363   private static Number readRadixInteger(String s, TomlTokenizer t) throws ParseException {
364      if (s == null || s.length() < 3 || s.charAt(0) != '0')
365         return null;
366      char p = s.charAt(1);
367      int radix;
368      if (p == 'x' || p == 'X')
369         radix = 16;
370      else if (p == 'o' || p == 'O')
371         radix = 8;
372      else if (p == 'b' || p == 'B')
373         radix = 2;
374      else
375         return null;
376      String digits = s.substring(2).replace("_", "");
377      if (digits.isEmpty())
378         throw t.parseException(MSG_INVALID_NUMBER + s);
379      try {
380         return Long.parseUnsignedLong(digits, radix);
381      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e) {
382         throw t.parseException(MSG_INVALID_NUMBER + s);
383      }
384   }
385
386   // Steps into a child table.  Per TOML, a header path that traverses an array of tables refers to its most recent element.
387   private static Object stepInto(Object current, String key) {
388      if (current instanceof List l && !l.isEmpty())
389         current = l.get(l.size() - 1);
390      return ((Map)current).computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>());
391   }
392
393   private static Map<String,Object> lastTable(Object current) {
394      if (current instanceof List l && !l.isEmpty())
395         current = l.get(l.size() - 1);
396      return (Map<String,Object>)current;
397   }
398
399   private static Object getOrCreateAt(Map<String,Object> root, String path) {
400      String[] parts = path.split("\\.");
401      Object current = root;
402      for (int i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++)
403         current = stepInto(current, parts[i]);
404      return lastTable(current).get(parts[parts.length - 1]);
405   }
406
407   private static Map<String,Object> getOrCreateTableAt(Map<String,Object> root, String path) {
408      String[] parts = path.split("\\.");
409      Object current = root;
410      for (String part : parts)
411         current = stepInto(current, part);
412      return lastTable(current);
413   }
414
415   private static void setAt(Map<String,Object> root, String path, Object value) {
416      String[] parts = path.split("\\.");
417      Object current = root;
418      for (int i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++)
419         current = stepInto(current, parts[i]);
420      lastTable(current).put(parts[parts.length - 1], value);
421   }
422
423   private static void setValueAt(Map<String,Object> root, List<String> keyPath, Object value) {
424      if (keyPath.size() == 1) {
425         root.put(keyPath.get(0), value);
426         return;
427      }
428      Object current = root;
429      for (int i = 0; i < keyPath.size() - 1; i++) {
430         current = ((Map)current).computeIfAbsent(keyPath.get(i), k -> new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>());
431      }
432      ((Map)current).put(keyPath.get(keyPath.size() - 1), value);
433   }
434
435   private <T> T convertMapToType(Map<String,Object> map, ClassMeta<T> type) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
436      if (type.isMap()) {
437         var keyType = type.getKeyType();
438         var valueType = type.getValueType();
439         Map m = type.canCreateNewInstance(getOuter()) ? (Map) type.newInstance(getOuter()) : newGenericMap(type);
440         for (var e : map.entrySet()) {
441            String keyStr = eq(e.getKey(), "null") ? null : e.getKey();
442            Object key = convertAttrToType(m, keyStr, keyType);
443            Object val = convertValue(e.getValue(), valueType);
444            m.put(key, val);
445         }
446         return (T) m;
447      }
448      BeanMap<?> bm = toBeanMap(type.newInstance(getOuter()));
449      populateBeanMap(bm, map);
450      return (T) checkRequired(bm).getBean();
451   }
452
453   private JsonMap toJsonMap(Map<?,?> map) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
454      var jm = new JsonMap();
455      for (Entry<?,?> e : map.entrySet()) {
456         Object k = e.getKey();
457         Object v = e.getValue();
458         Object converted = v instanceof Map v2 ? toJsonMap(v2) : convertValue(v, object());
459         jm.put(k == null ? "null" : k.toString(), converted);
460      }
461      return jm;
462   }
463
464   private void populateBeanMap(BeanMap<?> bm, Map<String,Object> map) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
465      for (Entry<String,Object> e : map.entrySet()) {
466         String key = e.getKey();
467         Object val = e.getValue();
468         BeanPropertyMeta pMeta = bm.getMeta().getProperties().get(key);
469         if (pMeta == null && isIgnoreUnknownBeanProperties())
470            continue;
471         if (pMeta == null)
472            throw new ParseException(this, "Unknown property '%s'", key);
473         ClassMeta<?> targetType = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
474         Object converted = convertValue(val, targetType);
475         bm.put(key, converted);
476      }
477   }
478
479   @SuppressWarnings({
480      "java:S9391" // Hot path; avoids stream allocation (and loop body throws checked exceptions).
481   })
482   private Object convertValue(Object val, ClassMeta<?> targetType) throws ParseException, ExecutableException {
483      if (val == null)
484         return null;
485      String nv = ctx != null ? ctx.getNullValue() : null;
486      if (val instanceof String val2 && nv != null && eq(val2, nv))
487         return null;
488      if (val instanceof Map val2) {
489         if (JsonMap.class.isAssignableFrom(targetType.inner()))
490            return toJsonMap(val2);
491         if (targetType.isBean()) {
492            BeanMap<?> child = toBeanMap(targetType.newInstance(getOuter()));
493            populateBeanMap(child, val2);
494            return checkRequired(child).getBean();
495         }
496      }
497      if (val instanceof List val2 && targetType.isCollectionOrArray()) {
498         ClassMeta<?> elType = targetType.getElementType();
499         List result = new ArrayList();
500         for (Object item : val2) {
501            result.add(convertValue(item, elType));
502         }
503         return targetType.isArray() ? toArray(targetType, result) : result;
504      }
505      // Bare numeric wire literals (e.g. "2024", "8100000000000") arrive here as Number values
506      // from the TOML tokenizer.  Route them through the format-aware parsers so the configured
507      // MarshallingContext.get<Format>() hint (NANOS, ISO_YEAR, MILLIS, …) reaches the coercion.
508      // Without this routing the generic Number → T coercion below would silently drop the hint
509      // (e.g. treating Long(2024) as epoch-millis → 1970-01-01T00:00:02.024Z instead of year 2024).
510      if (val instanceof Number val2) {
511         if (targetType.isNumber())
512            return convertToMemberType(null, val2, targetType);
513         if (targetType.isDuration())
514            return readDuration(val2.toString());
515         if (targetType.isPeriod())
516            return readPeriod(val2.toString());
517         if (targetType.isDate())
518            return readDate(val2.toString(), targetType);
519         if (targetType.isCalendar())
520            return readCalendar(val2.toString(), targetType);
521         if (targetType.isTemporal())
522            return readTemporal(val2.toString(), targetType);
523      }
524      if (val instanceof String val2) {
525         if (targetType.isDate())
526            return readDate(val2, targetType);
527         if (targetType.isCalendar())
528            return readCalendar(val2, targetType);
529         if (targetType.isTemporal())
530            return readTemporal(val2, targetType);
531         if (targetType.isDuration())
532            return readDuration(val2);
533         if (targetType.isPeriod())
534            return readPeriod(val2);
535      }
536      // Native TOML datetime literals (Z-zoned / offset / local) are returned by TomlTokenizer as
537      // java.time.OffsetDateTime / LocalDateTime / LocalDate / LocalTime objects.  Re-stringify
538      // through the temporal's own ISO toString() and route through readTemporal so the
539      // configured TemporalFormat hint (e.g. ISO_INSTANT) is honored — otherwise the generic
540      // Temporal → T coercion below applies the local zone and we lose the wire's UTC anchor.
541      if (val instanceof TemporalAccessor val2 && targetType.isTemporal())
542         return readTemporal(val2.toString(), targetType);
543      // Route String-shaped byte[] values (collection-element + top-level dispatch sites) through
544      // the configured BinaryFormat's variant binarySwap before falling through to the default
545      // String → byte[] coercion.  The bean-property path is unaffected because the per-property
546      // MPP install hides the type-level default swap behind the per-property swap.
547      var binBytes = tryUnswapByteArray(val, targetType);
548      if (binBytes != null)
549         return binBytes;
550      return convertToMemberType(null, val, targetType);
551   }
552
553   /**
554    * Routes a {@link String}-shaped {@code byte[]} value through the session-aware
555    * {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.swaps.BinarySwap} when one is matched.
556    *
557    * <p>Collection-element and top-level dispatch sites don't go through
558    * {@code MarshalledPropertyPostProcessor}'s per-property swap install, so they fall back to the
559    * {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.swap.spi.DefaultSwaps} registry.  Returns {@code null} when the target isn't
560    * {@code byte[]}, the value isn't a {@link String}, or no swap is matched on the current session
561    * (e.g. {@link BinaryFormat#NOT_SET} is configured).
562    */
563   @SuppressWarnings({
564      "java:S1168" // Null is a meaningful 'no byte[] unswap applies' signal; callers fall through on null (an empty array would wrongly mean 'unswapped to empty bytes').
565   })
566   private byte[] tryUnswapByteArray(Object val, ClassMeta<?> targetType) throws ParseException {
567      if (!(val instanceof String val2) || targetType == null || targetType.inner() != byte[].class)
568         return null;
569      var swap = targetType.getSwap(this);
570      if (swap == null)
571         return null;
572      return (byte[]) unswap(swap, val2, targetType);
573   }
574}
